name: Kor-Ingalls Route
overview: An ultra-classic tower route and probably the busiest of all, linking a series of corners that open leftward on the south wall: a crack and squeeze chimney, a jam crack, an off-width in a big dihedral, then a chimney behind a flake. Gear is adequate and it is easier than most desert towers.
descent: rap the route in four pitches, or better, descend the northern side with either two 200 ft doubled-rope raps or four 100 ft raps
